evals.prompt: Create a presentation for our Q1 2026 quarterly business review. Revenue was $4.2M (up 18% YoY), we launched 2 new products, have 3 key risks (supply chain delays, competitor pricing pressure, talent retention), and next quarter priorities are expanding into APAC, hiring 15 engineers, and shipping v3.0.
evals.expected_output: 8-slide HTML presentation with title slide, revenue/KPI stats, product launches, risks as cards, priorities as flow steps, next steps. Uses the design system typography, colors, spotlight hover, scroll-snap navigation.

evals.prompt: Make slides explaining our microservices migration. We're moving from a Django monolith to 6 services: auth, billing, notifications, search, content, analytics. Show the migration phases, key risks, and the target architecture.
evals.expected_output: 6-8 slide HTML presentation covering current state, target architecture (6 services), migration phases as flow steps, risks as cards, and timeline. Uses two-column layouts, data tables or principle lists for services.

evals.prompt: Create a new employee onboarding presentation. Cover: company mission, team structure (Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, 4 teams), first week checklist (5 steps), tools we use (Slack, Linear, GitHub, Figma), and who to contact for what.
evals.expected_output: 6-8 slide HTML presentation with title/mission slide, team structure as cards or principle list, first week as flow steps, tools as icon cards, contacts as sidebar rows. Friendly but professional tone.
